name: Orange-Spiced Chicken with Snap Peas, Carrots, Couscous & Peanuts

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir; cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups whole wheat couscous

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oranges
6 medium carrots
1 ½ (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the pot; cook, turning once, until golden brown on each side, 6-7 minutes (chicken will not be cooked through all the way).
Meanwhile, zest and juice oranges into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the orange juice.
Add water, sugar, soy sauce, ketchup, vinegar, and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup water
¼ cup brown sugar
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp ketchup
2 tbsp rice vinegar
½ tsp cayenne pepper
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
½ tsp cloves, ground

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and thinly slice carrots. Add carrots and snap peas to the pot, along with any chicken thighs that may have been removed if cooked in batches.

Add sauce to the pot and bring to a boil over high heat (reserve bowl for later use). Reduce heat and simmer, turning thighs occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, about 12 minutes.
While the chicken cooks, roughly chop peanuts.
Trim green onions and cut into ¼-inch pieces.

In the reserved bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth. Add to the pot in a steady stream, while stirring constantly; continue to simmer, until sauce thickens, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chicken-vegetable sauté and couscous between plates or bowls. Top with peanuts and green onion. Enjoy!
